gaps.detail: Thaumometer icon aliases the original scanner UV atlas byte-for-byte; scanner.obj and hand/screen rendering are not implemented.
Foundation wand is a static layered original rod/cap icon; dynamic TC4 rod/cap/focus geometry and use poses remain to port.
Crystals use an original tinted crystal sprite on crossed planes; six-piece randomized 3D clusters and attachment orientation remain to port.
Jar uses the existing two-box shell with original face textures; essentia fill, labels, brain/node/void variants need dedicated rendering.
Aura node block has empty geometry; its item uses a diagnostic shard marker. Original node rings, reveal visibility and drain beams are not implemented.

Thaumonomicon map and completed text/illustration pages use the original corpus. Item-backed node icons, recipe pages, original line animations, research table and puzzle remain pending; visual parity is not established.

Shard/crystal models use tint index 0 and original RGB values. Filled phials use the aspect component color at tint index 1 while layer 0 stays white. Loader clients must register these providers and jar/crystal cutout layers.
OBJ/MTL text content is preserved with canonical LF newlines; these references are not auto-loaded, and internal paths/legacy formats still need a modern renderer importer.
Legacy shader/program, blockstate, model and recipe JSON are deliberately not bulk-copied. Only approved foundation IDs receive modern models.
Resource coverage is not gameplay or visual parity. The 19 material items are foundation identities, not completed TC4 item behaviors.
